class Turbojet(pyc.Cycle):
    def setup(self):
        # design conditions
        self.options['thermo_method'] = 'TABULAR'
        self.options['thermo_data'] = pyc.AIR_JETA_TAB_SPEC
        self.options['output_flow_stations'] = ['exit_bp']

        self.pyc_add_element('flight', pyc.FlightConditions(MN=0.0, alt=0.0))
        self.pyc_add_element('inlet', pyc.Inlet())
        self.pyc_add_element('compressor', pyc.Compressor(map_data=axi5, design=True))
        self.pyc_add_element('burner', pyc.Combustor())
        self.pyc_add_element('turbine', pyc.Turbine(map_data=lpt2269, design=True))
        self.pyc_add_element('nozzle', pyc.Nozzle(lossCoef=0.99))
        self.pyc_add_element('shaft', pyc.Shaft(num_ports=2))

        # connect flow station
        self.connect('flight.Ps', 'inlet.Ps')
        self.connect('flight.Ts', 'inlet.Ts')
        self.connect('inlet.Fl_O', 'compressor.Fl_I')
        self.connect('compressor.Fl_O', 'burner.Fl_I')
        self.connect('burner.Fl_O', 'turbine.Fl_I')
        self.connect('turbine.Fl_O', 'nozzle.Fl_I')

        self.connect('shaft.trq_1', 'compressor.trq')
        self.connect('shaft.trq_2', 'turbine.trq')
        self.connect('shaft.Nmech', 'compressor.Nmech')
        self.connect('shaft.Nmech', 'turbine.Nmech')

        self.connect('flight.MN', 'nozzle.MN')

        # balance connections
        self.connect('compressor.Fl_O:tot:P', 'burner.Pt')
        self.connect('turbine.Fl_O:tot:P', 'nozzle.Pt')
        self.connect('burner.dPt', 'nozzle.dPtot')

        # design balances
        self.pyc_add_cycle_param('burner.dPqP', 0.03)
        self.pyc_add_cycle_param('inlet.ram_recovery', 1.0)
        self.pyc_add_cycle_param('inlet.lossCoef', 1.0)

        balance = self.add_subsystem('balance', om.BalanceComp(), promotes_inputs=['*'], promotes_outputs=['*'])

        # balance on fuel flow to hit T4

class TurbojetDesign(om.Group):
    def setup(self):
